dialogue.content: [本日は宜しくお願い致します。」
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming today. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: (はい、宜しくお願い致します)
dialogue.English: (Yes, thank you. I look forward to it as well.)

dialogue.content: 「こちらこそ、宜しくお願い致します。何かリクエスト希望あれば気軽に相談してくださいね。」
dialogue.English: The pleasure is mine. If you have any requests, please feel free to let me know.

dialogue.content: 時間になったら、始めますね宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: We’ll begin when it’s time. Thank you.

dialogue.content: (はい、承知致しました。)
dialogue.English: (Yes, I understand.)

dialogue.content: 「宜しくお願い致します。」
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 本日は相談しに来てくれてありがとうございます。相談員です。はじめに年齢、性別、宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. I'm your counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: こんにちは。はい、54歳女です。
dialogue.English: Hello. Yes, I’m a 54-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 本日相談したい内容と呼んでも大丈夫なお名前宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Could you please tell me what you'd like to discuss today and a name I can call you by?

dialogue.content: 相談したい内容としましては、義理の母との関係です。名前はユリコ(仮名)で。
dialogue.English: I’d like to discuss my relationship with my mother-in-law. You can call me Yuriko (pseudonym).

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 義理のお母さんとの関係で相談なんですね。
dialogue.English: So, you'd like to discuss your relationship with your mother-in-law.

dialogue.content: ユリコさんとお母さんのことについてもう少し詳しく聴いても大丈夫ですか
dialogue.English: May I hear a bit more about you and your mother-in-law, Yuriko?

dialogue.content: ええ、同居している義理の母とどうも合わなくて
dialogue.English: Yes, I just don't get along with my mother-in-law, who lives with us.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 昔からですが、母は家事をきちんとこなす人でそうしないと気が済まないようなところがあります。
dialogue.English: It's been this way for a long time, but my mother-in-law is the type of person who has to do all the housework perfectly; she can't seem to rest unless it's done that way.

dialogue.content: 最近は年老いてきて、ひとつこなすのも一苦労といった様子なのですが、そんなに大変なら料理なんて無理にしなければいいのにと思うのです。
dialogue.English: Recently, she's gotten older, and it seems like every single task is a struggle for her. I think if it's that difficult, she shouldn't force herself to cook.

dialogue.content: お母さんと合わないというのは家事以外も昔からでしょうか
dialogue.English: Have you always felt you don't get along with her, even in matters besides housework?

dialogue.content: でも母はやらないと気が済まない様でして
dialogue.English: But it seems she just can't be satisfied unless she does it.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s right.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: それは、とても大変ですね
dialogue.English: That must be very difficult.

dialogue.content: 世間体とかもかなり気にするので近所の人にどう思われるとか、よく言っています。
dialogue.English: She's also very concerned with appearances, so she often talks about what the neighbors might think.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: お母さんは気にしすぎる性格なんですね。
dialogue.English: So, your mother-in-law tends to worry too much.

dialogue.content: 気にしすぎるというか、自分がよく思われたいという感じですね。
dialogue.English: It’s less about worrying and more that she wants to be thought well of.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: あそこのお母さんは料理も毎日して身なりも綺麗にして、素晴らしいわね。と言われたい様です。
dialogue.English: It's like she wants people to say, "That mother over there cooks every day, keeps herself looking nice, and is so wonderful."

dialogue.content: よく思われたいがためにお母さんはやりすぎなのですね
dialogue.English: So she overdoes things because she wants to be thought of highly.

dialogue.content: そうですね、自意識過剰なんでしょうね
dialogue.English: Yes, I suppose she’s overly self-conscious.

dialogue.content: それでは、ユリコさんも気持ちも精神的にも苦痛で大変ですね
dialogue.English: In that case, this must be emotionally and mentally painful and difficult for you, Yuriko.

dialogue.content: 何というか、本当に合わないなって。
dialogue.English: It's just... we really don't get along.

dialogue.content: 最近は歳のせいか丸くなって
dialogue.English: Recently, maybe with age, she’s mellowed a bit,

dialogue.content: 小言も減りましたが
dialogue.English: and the nagging has decreased, but

dialogue.content: 昔は嫌味もよく言われましたしよくむかつきましたね
dialogue.English: in the past, she would often make sarcastic remarks, and it really irritated me.

dialogue.content: 今回はその自意識過剰なお母さんとどうすれば楽にお付き合いをできるかどうかで相談に来たということで良かったでしょうか。
dialogue.English: So, is it correct to say that you've come here today to discuss how you can interact with your overly self-conscious mother-in-law more comfortably?

dialogue.content: ええ、まあそうですね。自分はどう捉えていればいいかなと。あと愚痴を話せる場が無いので話せればいいみたいなところもありますが。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's about right. I'm wondering how I should think about the situation. Also, since I don't have a place to vent, I was also hoping to just be able to talk about it.

dialogue.content: 色々昔は嫌味も言われてたんですねよく耐えられてえらいと思いますよ頑張ってますね
dialogue.English: It sounds like you were subjected to a lot of sarcastic comments in the past. I think you're admirable for having endured it. You've been working so hard.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: I can imagine.

dialogue.content: 主人も母の味方でしたのでしんどかったですね
dialogue.English: My husband was on his mother’s side too, so it was tough.

dialogue.content: それは、さらにしんどいですね
dialogue.English: That must have made it even tougher.

dialogue.content: ある時は、「母の日のプレゼントは用意してあるのか！」と怒鳴ってきたり
dialogue.English: One time, he yelled at me, "Have you prepared a Mother's Day gift?!"

dialogue.content: 気持ち悪いですよね
dialogue.English: It's creepy, isn't it?

dialogue.content: ご主人までお母さんの見方だともうどうしていいかわからなくなりますよね
dialogue.English: When even your husband is on her side, it must feel like you don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: そんなことまで言われるんですね
dialogue.English: To think he would say something like that to you.

dialogue.content: どう思います？そんな旦那
dialogue.English: What do you think of a husband like that?

dialogue.content: ユリコさんはそれに対して言い返したりはありましたか
dialogue.English: Did you ever talk back to him about that, Yuriko?

dialogue.content: 用意してないと言うと買ってこいと言われ、従っていましたね。
dialogue.English: If I said I hadn't prepared one, he'd tell me to go buy one, and I would comply.

dialogue.content: 私だったらとおもうと耐えられないと思います辛すぎて
dialogue.English: If I were in your shoes, I don't think I could bear it. It would be too painful.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですよね嫌気が差しますよ
dialogue.English: Yes, exactly. It's just sickening.

dialogue.content: 今の今までとても辛くて大変な思いをしてきたんですね
dialogue.English: You've gone through so much pain and hardship up until now.

dialogue.content: 今思うと、何で反抗しなかったんだろうと…
dialogue.English: Looking back now, I wonder why I didn’t stand up for myself...

dialogue.content: 考えただけでもしんどさが伝わってきました
dialogue.English: Just thinking about it, I can feel how difficult it must have been.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: ええ、有難う御座います。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: とてもえらいと思います
dialogue.English: I think you are very admirable.

dialogue.content: これからもし母の介護とかあっても私には出来ないと思うんです。
dialogue.English: If it comes to caring for her in the future, I don't think I can do it.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: That's understandable.

dialogue.content: 私でも同じ立場にあればそう思います
dialogue.English: I would feel the same way in your position.

dialogue.content: これまでの事が蘇って怒りに変わった時、正直何してしまうか分からないです、毎日のことですから。
dialogue.English: When past events resurface and turn into anger, honestly, I don't know what I might do, since it's an everyday thing.

dialogue.content: そうなりますよね
dialogue.English: That's understandable.

dialogue.content: ご主人には将来のお母さんのことについて話されたりはまだないですか
dialogue.English: Have you talked with your husband yet about your mother-in-law’s future?

dialogue.content: 少し話したことはありますが…母は私は他の老人と違う！と施設に入りたがらない人ですから家で見ることになると思っています。
dialogue.English: We've talked about it a little... but my mother-in-law is the type who refuses to go into a facility, saying, "I'm different from other old people!" so I expect we'll have to care for her at home.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: それでも、きっと大変なことになりますし訪問看護等利用できるのは利用したほうがいいと思います
dialogue.English: Even so, it will surely be very difficult, so I think you should use any available services, like visiting nurses.

dialogue.content: お母さんとユリコさんお互いのためにも
dialogue.English: For the sake of both your mother-in-law and you, Yuriko.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですよね考えるだけでぞっとします。
dialogue.English: Yes, you're right. I shudder just thinking about it.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私も聴いてるだけでも自分のことのように思えてきました
dialogue.English: Even just listening, I can almost feel it as if it were happening to me.

dialogue.content: 私も仕事がありますので出来るだけ自分の時間を持ちたいのです。
dialogue.English: I have a job too, so I want to have as much of my own time as possible.

dialogue.content: 食事や最低限のことくらいでできるならそのほうがいいですよね。
dialogue.English: If you can keep it to meals and the bare minimum, that would be better, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: でも母はお嫁さんにも大切に思われてる自分を周りに見せつけたいんですよね。
dialogue.English: But my mother-in-law wants to show off to everyone how cherished she is by her daughter-in-law.

dialogue.content: 仕事もありますしそのほうがいいですよ
dialogue.English: You have work, too, so that would be better.

dialogue.content: ほんとにくだらないと思うのですが…
dialogue.English: I know it sounds really trivial, but...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 主人には兄がいてその方は10代で亡くなられているので私は会ったことないのですが
dialogue.English: My husband had an older brother who passed away in his teens, so I've never met him, but...

dialogue.content: それは結構面倒でたいへことですね
dialogue.English: That sounds quite complicated and difficult.

dialogue.content: どうも自殺だったみたいなんです。
dialogue.English: It seems it was suicide.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Oh.

dialogue.content: それは、ビックリしたんじゃないですか
dialogue.English: That must have been a shock.

dialogue.content: ええ、それは主人から聞いたんですけどね
dialogue.English: Yes, I heard that from my husband, though.

dialogue.content: 母は絶対に言いませんから。
dialogue.English: My mother-in-law would never mention it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 母の性格とかを考えたら、そのお兄さんも相当生きにくかったんじゃないかなと思って
dialogue.English: Considering my mother-in-law's personality, I think her older son must have had a very difficult life.

dialogue.content: お母さんかなり頑固さんなんですね
dialogue.English: Your mother-in-law is quite stubborn, isn't she?

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: これは私の想像ですが。
dialogue.English: This is just my speculation, though.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, she is.

dialogue.content: きっと生きにくかったんではないかなと思いますよ
dialogue.English: I imagine life must have been very difficult for him.

dialogue.content: ええ、私がそう言う気持ちになっているのできっとそうだったのかもしれないと心が痛くなりました
dialogue.English: Yes, because I feel this way myself, my heart aches to think that it might have been the same for him.

dialogue.content: そんなお母さんとであればですけど
dialogue.English: Especially with a mother like that.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: I can imagine.

dialogue.content: ユリコさん体調は大丈夫でしょうか
dialogue.English: Yuriko, how is your health? Are you okay?

dialogue.content: 少し不眠気味です
dialogue.English: I'm having a little trouble sleeping.

dialogue.content: そうなりますよね
dialogue.English: That's understandable.

dialogue.content: 眠れないときは、どうしてることが多いですか
dialogue.English: When you can’t sleep, what do you usually do?

dialogue.content: スマホをいじったりしていますね。占いが好きなので、そういうのを見たり
dialogue.English: I'm usually on my phone. I like fortune-telling, so I'll look at things like that.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 占いが好きなんて言うと、娘には馬鹿にされてしまうのですが
dialogue.English: When I say I like fortune-telling, my daughter makes fun of me, though.

dialogue.content: どんな占い見ることが多いですか
dialogue.English: What kind of fortune-telling do you usually look at?

dialogue.content: いえいえ私も好きでいいことだけ信じてみます
dialogue.English: Oh, not at all—I like it too. I just choose to believe the good parts.

dialogue.content: ゲッターズ飯田さんの占いはよく見ています。本も買ったりして。
dialogue.English: I often look at Getters Iida's fortune-telling. I've even bought his books.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ええ、面白いですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, it's interesting, isn't it?

dialogue.content: ユリコさんのおすすめなんですね
dialogue.English: So that’s your recommendation, Yuriko.

dialogue.content: なんとなく、自分に合っている気がしています。
dialogue.English: Somehow, it feels like it suits me.

dialogue.content: 今度私もチェックしようかなあうものだといいですよね。
dialogue.English: Maybe I'll check it out sometime. It's nice when you find something that resonates with you.

dialogue.content: 他にもみる占いはあるんですか
dialogue.English: Are there any other types of fortune-telling you look at?

dialogue.content: 占いというより、神社に行ったりもします。
dialogue.English: It's not exactly fortune-telling, but I also go to shrines.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 本当にくだらないかもしれないですけど心の拠り所みたいなものを欲してるのかもしれません
dialogue.English: It might sound silly, but I think I might be looking for some kind of emotional anchor.

dialogue.content: 神社も好きなんですね
dialogue.English: So you like shrines, too.

dialogue.content: 今まで生きてきて、自分を抑えてきたことが多かったので。母に対しても主人に対しても金銭的な不安がなければ離れていましたね、きっと。
dialogue.English: I've suppressed my own feelings for most of my life. If it weren't for financial worries, I'm sure I would have left both my mother-in-law and my husband.

dialogue.content: 心の拠り所ですか自分の居場所や落ち着く所必要ですもんね
dialogue.English: An emotional anchor... It's important to have a place where you belong, a place where you can feel at peace.

dialogue.content: 抑えてきたが故に自分が何者なんだろうと感じる事もよくあります。何者でも無い無力な自分にがっかりします。
dialogue.English: Because I've suppressed myself so much, I often feel like I don't know who I am. I get disappointed in my powerless self, feeling like I'm nobody.

dialogue.content: 今までの我慢と苦痛がありますもんね金銭的な不安もあるんでしょうか
dialogue.English: You have all that endurance and pain from the past. Are there financial worries as well?

dialogue.content: とても辛いですよね
dialogue.English: That must be very painful.

dialogue.content: ええ、娘が2人いますし、と言ってももう成人なので家は出ていますが
dialogue.English: Yes, I have two daughters, although they're adults now and have moved out.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 私はパートなので稼ぎも多く無いですし一人でやっていく自信もないので…
dialogue.English: I only work part-time, so I don't earn much, and I don't have the confidence to make it on my own...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 一人だと大変ですもんね
dialogue.English: It's hard being on your own, isn't it?

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: そうだと思います
dialogue.English: I imagine so.

dialogue.content: 周りのお友達や身内には相談できてたりしますか
dialogue.English: Have you been able to talk about this with any friends or family?

dialogue.content: 話したりしますが、話したあと虚しくなったりして最近は言わないようにしています。
dialogue.English: I have sometimes, but I often feel empty afterward, so lately I've been trying not to.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 一人で何にも出来ないのに愚痴ばかり言っている自分がかっこ悪くて
dialogue.English: I feel pathetic for just complaining all the time when I can't do anything on my own.

dialogue.content: すみません、こんな話を次から次へと
dialogue.English: I’m sorry for going on and on like this.

dialogue.content: やはり気遣いもしますもんね
dialogue.English: It shows how considerate you are of others' feelings.

dialogue.content: そんな事ないですよ
dialogue.English: Not at all.

dialogue.content: 人間一人では何もできないですし私も愚痴のひとつくらい言いたいこともあるので
dialogue.English: No one can do everything on their own, and I have things I want to vent about, too.

dialogue.content: むしろ話してくれてありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: In fact, thank you for sharing this with me.

dialogue.content: ええ、なんだか少しスッキリしました。
dialogue.English: Yes, I feel a bit lighter now.

dialogue.content: 少しでも気持ちがスッキリできて嬉しいです。
dialogue.English: I’m glad you were able to feel even a little lighter.

dialogue.content: 今日話したいこと話せていますか
dialogue.English: Have you been able to talk about everything you wanted to today?

dialogue.content: 話せました。何か気持ちの面で、どういう心情でいたらいいとか、ありますか？
dialogue.English: Yes, I have. Do you have any advice on what kind of mindset I should try to have?

dialogue.content: よかったです
dialogue.English: I’m glad.

dialogue.content: そうですね。あくまでも私の主観ですがお母さんはそうゆう人だからと考えを変えて見ると少しはらくかもしれません
dialogue.English: Well, this is just my personal view, but it might become a little easier if you can change your perspective to, "That's just the kind of person she is."

dialogue.content: ええ、なるほど
dialogue.English: Yes, I see.

dialogue.content: 相手は変えられないと思いますので
dialogue.English: Since I don't think you can change other people,

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: That’s true.

dialogue.content: 自分の考えや行動を変えるしかないので
dialogue.English: the only thing to do is change your own thoughts and actions.

dialogue.content: とてもしんどいとは思いますが
dialogue.English: I know it's very difficult, though.

dialogue.content: はい、出来るだけ努力します
dialogue.English: Yes, I’ll do my best.

dialogue.content: 無茶だけはしすぎずに徐々にでいいと思いますのでちょっと気楽に考えてお母さんと割り切っていい関係になれるといいなと思います
dialogue.English: Just don't push yourself too hard. I think it's fine to take it gradually. I hope you can take it a bit more lightly, create some emotional distance, and build a better relationship with your mother-in-law.

dialogue.content: ええ、分かりました。
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand.

dialogue.content: 色々とありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for everything.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: You’re welcome.

dialogue.content: 参考にさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: I'll keep your advice in mind.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました
dialogue.English: No, thank you.

dialogue.content: 少しでも参考になれたら幸いです。
dialogue.English: I hope it was helpful, even in a small way.

dialogue.content: また何かあればいつでも相談に来てくださいね。
dialogue.English: If anything else comes up, please feel free to come and talk anytime.

dialogue.content: ええ、また宜しくお願い致します。本日はありがとうございました、失礼致します。
dialogue.English: Yes, I will. Thank you for today. Goodbye.

dialogue.content: それでは失礼いたします。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Goodbye then. Thank you.

dialogue.content: (ロープレ有難う御座いました、また宜しくお願い致します！)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the role-play. I look forward to working with you again!)

dialogue.content: こちらこそ本日ありがとうございました失礼いたしますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well for today. Goodbye.

dialogue.content: 「ありがとうございましたこちらこそまたよろしくお願いいたします」
dialogue.English: “Thank you very much. Likewise, I look forward to working with you again.”
